$comment: The quality baseline manifest. It is EMPTY on purpose: the repository ships no
reference images, and the baseline is meaningless without licensed ones.
See docs/quality-baseline.md for how to populate it.
path         relative to this manifest, under baseline-references/
sha256       content hash; recomputed and cross-checked on every sweep
subjectClass one of object | character | hybrid | built-environment
licence      the terms under which this image may be redistributed
referenceId  must name a references[] id
runIndex     0-based; run one reference at least three times so spread is measured
`environment` is produced by baseline.environment_record(). Any null field is
also listed in `unresolved`, and a baseline with unresolved fields is refused
for comparison rather than silently compared.
